messages:
maria.g: Quick request for launch assets: can runtime run a small sanity sweep on our launch cohort? Need p95/p99, coldstart heatmap, and 6 sample outputs for the press pack.

sam.runtime: Yep. Recommend ~200 requests, short/medium/long mix, two quant modes (fp16 + q4_0). Do you want embeddings included?

alex.marketing: Include embeddings for the demo flow. Deliverables: metrics.csv (per-request latency + trace_id), heatmap.png, sample-responses.jsonl, and a tiny README with methodology (warm vs cold).

maria.g: Important: one fully cold run + one warmed run. Label runs with run_id and run_ts. Sequence cap 2048. Primary model rdl-13B-v1, quantized rdl-13B-q4_0.

jess: Also redact any PII in examples; marketing will reuse samples in slides and a blog. If you see a notable regression, flag it in the README.

sam.runtime: Running on staging-dedicated (us-west2). Will include a run command snippet for docs. If job queues, ETA might slip to Friday AM.

deploy-bot: scheduled job started (job_id: run-ops-4891) 1: logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/run-ops-4891

alex.marketing: Helpful if one sample demonstrates a benign failure (hallucination/repetition) so we can be transparent in the webinar.

sam.runtime: Will include a flagged example if present; otherwise note that cohort didn't reveal major regressions. Dropping artifacts to /handoffs/marketing/launch-cohort-mar2026. Ping sam.runtime for expedite.
